items.html: And the matter is that within this Hochma is included the Bina, namely Ima, and the letters are from Bina; so the twenty-two letters are found included in the Bina within this Hochma. And the ten utterances, with which Ima became pregnant and gave birth to them in the secret of 'And God said,' which is Bina — and they are ten: nine of ZA, and Malchut; behold, ten. And it is found that also Malchut, which is the conclusion, is included in this Hochma. And this is what is said: 'and in this Hochma the beginning and the conclusion are found.' And therefore: upper Hochma, and lower Hochma, which is the wisdom of Shlomo.
